items.title: OKC will be eligible for a hardship exception with Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace & Jalen Williams out long-term.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
OKC will be eligible for a hardship exception with Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace & Jalen Williams out long-term.

Challenge is that a hardship exception is a roster exception, not a cap exception. After signing Ochai Agbaji, OKC will be only about $4.6M under the second apron.
